deliberation: A dependency-driven three-day topology is viable: authority and schema freeze precedes hostile validation, which precedes shadow replay, which precedes Article XI assembly and independent readback. The T+48 pre-pilot gate and T+66 acceptance gate prevent schedule pressure from reaching downstream authority edges.
discharged_obligations: Mapped the accelerated critical path and authority barrier.
findings: Parallel work can shorten elapsed time without reordering prerequisites.
One class and one repository are the defensible initial terrain.
amendments: Block each failed node and all descendants; never infer completion.
residual_uncertainty: External repository and identity systems may not support isolated replay in time.
